notes:
Accept after corrections made in place. The review was done by Claude Code (session cc-38267a) against arXiv v5 (SHA-256 6c260021…, the extraction's file) and its TeX source, with four checkers (§§1–3, §§4–6, §§7–9, Appendices A–B); to check imports they also read FKP19 (arXiv 1904.02374v5), Allen–Newton–Thorne (arXiv 1912.11269v2) and Pan (arXiv 1901.07166v2). The coordinator re-derived every substantive finding in the TeX. The published text was again not read; Crossref records no update. 58 items were corrected. The material ones: 17, 21, 22 (§3: quantifier order, local lifts at S, Proposition 3.8's conclusion); 33 (Proposition 5.4 concerns the relative classes); 41, 42, 43 (Corollary 6.6, Remark 6.7, Example 6.8); 66, 67, 71, 72 (§9); 80, 81, 82, 85 (Appendix A). 25 items were added, giving 119 (13 planned, 106 missing). Source issues: E1–E7 are confirmed; E8–E44 are new. The substantive ones:
- E21, E22: Corollary 6.6 omits oddness, which Theorem 5.2 needs, and the absolute M-irreducibility that its Lemma A.14 alternative needs.
- E23–E25: Remark 6.7's subtorus claim fails for SL_2; Example 6.8's dihedral case misses the dual invariants (δ = ε_Kκ̄^r), and its criterion uses the wrong character.
- E32: Proposition 9.1's hypotheses do not give Allen–Newton–Thorne's (7) when ρ̄ has several constituents.
- E30: Remark 8.2's 'p ≫_n 0' is false (q ≡ −1 mod p).
- E36–E41: false clauses in Lemmas A.9, A.10, A.11 and Examples A.16, A.17; Lemma A.9's pairwise condition (3) fails for three summands, so Corollary 8.4's proof covers only r = 2 as printed (E37).
- Proof gaps with routine repairs: E12 (local lifts at S), E16 (FKP19 Cor. B.2 for disconnected G), E17 (γ_2 in Proposition 5.4 for non-simple 𝔤^der), E18–E20 (§6), E28 (the character ω in Theorem 7.4), E31, E35, E42, E43 (Lemma B.3's ideal).
Theorems 5.2 (= E), 7.4 (= B) and Corollary 8.3 (= C) stand once the proof gaps are repaired.
